objective: Run Identity Governance (EFAP): prevent cross-run data contamination via a canonical identity authority (src/governance/run_identity.py), always-on artifact identity stamping (run_id/config_version/config_hash/dataset_hash/artifact_timestamp/identity_status) in ReportWriter, a run_identity.json manifest per run dir, and a can_join() join-gate + validate-join CLI that DENIES any join involving an UNVERIFIED operand, a cross-run mismatch, or a config_hash drift. Historic pre-2026-09-16 artifacts are never backfilled (RECOMPUTE != RECOVER): they remain UNVERIFIED.
change_class_rationale: Adds the Run-Identity Governance surface (EFAP) — a new change class covering the canonical identity authority, always-on stamping, the run_identity.json manifest, and the can_join() gate + CLI. Purely additive: the writer's new run_identity param defaults to None so every pre-existing write_all caller is unaffected. Does NOT touch trading math, the L0-L5 identity-store substrate (IDENTITY_STORE_CHANGE), or the dataset-admission registry (CORPUS_AUTHORITY_CHANGE).
rollback_boundary: Single commit; revert run_identity.py + ReportWriter identity wiring + tests + change_contracts.json RUN_IDENTITY_CHANGE + this manifest together. Reverting must not orphan tests/test_run_identity.py or leave can_join() referenced without the module.
authority_granted: User toggled to Act mode 2026-09-19; approved Phase 1 execution of the Run Identity Governance plan.
authority_NOT_granted: No production approval, no promotion, no ACTIVE_VERSION change, no G001, no backfill/recovery of historic run hashes, no change to trading math or dataset-admission behavior.
